questions.question: How does ThingSpeak compare to AWS IoT Core?

answers.a: ThingSpeak is easier for beginners; AWS IoT Core is more advanced and scalable

questions.question: Why does AWS IoT Core require certificates?

answers.b: To provide secure authentication and encryption

questions.question: What role does an MQTT topic play in cloud communication?

answers.b: It acts as a channel for organizing and routing messages

questions.question: Why is device identity important in IBM Bluemix?

answers.b: To uniquely authenticate each device on the platform

questions.question: How does Azure IoT Hub ensure secure data transfer?

answers.b: By using protocols like HTTPS and MQTT with security tokens

questions.question: Why are dashboards important in IoT platforms?

answers.b: They visualize sensor data for analysis and monitoring

questions.question: Which of the following is a real-life application example?
How do visualization tools help developers?

answers.a: By reducing the number of sensors needed
answers.b: By showing real-time data trends for debugging and improvements

questions.question: What happens if Wi-Fi disconnects during cloud transmission?

answers.b: Data is delayed or lost until reconnection

questions.question: How do cloud systems support IoT scalability?

answers.a: By limiting the number of devices
answers.b: By allowing thousands of devices to connect and process data efficiently
